title: EFE DR drill outcome (D40 extended, schema v2)
description: Sprint D40 — extended DR drill outcome that supersedes the implicit v1 shape used by the D17 weekly drill. Adds `drill_kind`, `phases` (per-phase wall-clock breakdown), `helloworld` (D40 quarterly only), `compliance_frameworks`, and `attestation_*` fields. v1 readers ignore the new fields ; v2 readers reading a v1 file synthesise `drill_kind="weekly"` and `helloworld=null`.

schema_version.description: Pinned schema version. v1 was the implicit D17 shape ; v2 is the explicit D40 GA baseline.

drill_kind.description: Cadence label. Weekly = D17 routine drill (5 verifiers). Quarterly = D40 runbook drill (5 verifiers + Hello-World + compliance evidence).

finished_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp. Drill finished_at (success OR failure).

duration_secs.description: Wall-clock duration in seconds. Computed as finished_at - started_at.

rto_target_secs.description: RTO target for this drill kind. 1800s for weekly ; 2700s for quarterly (45 min, accounts for bootstrap-from-zero overhead).

within_rto.description: True iff duration_secs <= rto_target_secs. Drives SLO D40-DR-1.

phases.description: Per-phase wall-clock breakdown. Quarterly drill ONLY (weekly drill leaves this null).

kind_setup_secs.description: Phase 1 — kind cluster bootstrap + minio + cnpg installation.

helm_install_secs.description: Phase 2 — `helm upgrade --install` of the EFE chart.

restore_secs.description: Phase 3 — `dr/restore.sh` end-to-end (vault → postgres → bundles → helm-upgrade → verify → smoke).

cleanup_secs.description: Phase 6 — kind cluster destroy + evidence pack upload.

verifiers.description: Per-verifier outcome. 5 canonical verifiers always present : audit_chain, bundle_signatures, oidc_issuers, catalog_smoke, execute_smoke.

helloworld.description: Quarterly drill ONLY (D40). null for weekly drill outcomes.

compliance_frameworks.description: Compliance frameworks this drill provides evidence for. The D40 quarterly drill always asserts the four frameworks ; the D17 weekly drill asserts none (insufficient cadence + scope).

attestation_signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature over the SHA-256 of the canonicalised JSON (excluding this field). Allows external auditors to verify the evidence pack was signed by the documented attestation key.

attestation_pubkey_id.description: Symbolic pub-key id (e.g. `drill-attestation-2026`) cross-referenced in the trust store under `EFE_ATTESTATION_TRUST_STORE_PATH`.

success_overall.description: True iff within_rto AND every verifier.ok AND (helloworld == null OR helloworld.all_steps_ok).
